latest_release.name: OpenIDEA v0.1.53
latest_release.body:
OpenIDEA 0.1.53 fixes macOS keyboard shortcuts that stopped working in 0.1.52, and adds an interactive database ER diagram, run and debug for .NET project files, Hungry Backspace and other editor actions, annotate gutter name formats, download mirrors tried in order, a Reduce motion setting, and Plugin API 1.17.

### Download

|---|---|---|---|
| x86-64 (64-bit) | [EXE](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA_0.1.53_x64-setup.exe)   [MSI](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA_0.1.53_x64_en-US.msi)   [Portable](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA_0.1.53_windows_x64_portable.zip) | [Intel](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA_0.1.53_x64.dmg) | [AppImage](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA_0.1.53_amd64.AppImage)   [DEB](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA_0.1.53_amd64.deb)   [RPM](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA-0.1.53-1.x86_64.rpm) |
| AArch64 (ARM64) | [EXE](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA_0.1.53_arm64-setup.exe)   [MSI](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA_0.1.53_arm64_en-US.msi)   [Portable](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA_0.1.53_windows_arm64_portable.zip) | [Apple Silicon](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA_0.1.53_aarch64.dmg) | [AppImage](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA_0.1.53_aarch64.AppImage)   [DEB](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA_0.1.53_arm64.deb)   [RPM](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/OpenIDEA-0.1.53-1.aarch64.rpm) |

**Remote development:** `openidea-server` for [Linux x86-64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/openidea-server-linux-x86_64.gz) · [Linux ARM64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/openidea-server-linux-aarch64.gz) · [macOS x86-64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/openidea-server-macos-x86_64.gz) · [macOS ARM64](https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea/releases/download/v0.1.53/openidea-server-macos-aarch64.gz), each with a `.sha256` file.

**Already installed?** OpenIDEA updates itself: use **Check for Updates**.

## What's new

### Fixed in this release
- **macOS:** Command shortcuts work again (Settings, Find Action, tool windows, Recent Files, copy and paste, undo and the rest), which 0.1.52 lost. The Open Local Browser panel added in 0.1.52 caused this and is taken out for now.
- Undoing back to the saved text clears the file's modified mark; the Build output says how many earlier lines its line cap discarded and copies the whole log after Select All; console lines cut at 8,000 characters are found and copied as one line.

### Editor
- New actions: Hungry Backspace, Cut up to Line End, Delete to Line Start / End, Copy as Plain Text / Rich Text, Split and Move Right / Down, Expand / Collapse Doc Comments.
- Go to Declaration no longer waits behind Code Vision usage counts.

### Run, build and debug
- Run and debug a .NET project file from the Project view.
- JUnit 4 tests run from the gutter without Maven; Test Runner option *Select First Failed Test When Finished*.
- The toolbar hammer builds the selected run configuration; uv run keeps its own options.

### Database
- Interactive ER diagram with unique keys and indexes, and Show Diagram Popup; table grants in Modify Table; read-only PostgreSQL queries protected behind transaction poolers.

### Version control
- Options › Names in the annotate gutter (initials, last, first or full name); Show in Git Log from File History; the Git Branch widget shows the whole branch name.

detail.readme:
The IDE you know, rebuilt in Rust.

English · 简体中文 · Türkçe

Download  ·  Docs  ·  Benchmark  ·  Plugins  ·  Community

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/234dd54c-1255-4b3a-b35c-533d78d737c0 OpenIDEA brings the IntelliJ IDEA way of working — its keymap, its tool windows, its search-everything habits — to a native app with a Rust core. Editor, code insight, debugger, Git, terminal, database and HTTP clients, for 60+ languages. Builds for macOS, Windows and Linux. On macOS you can also install it with Homebrew: ```bash brew install --cask l0ng-ai/tap/openidea ``` ## Benchmark Opening [freqtrade](https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade) (Python, ~770 files) with warm caches, median of 5 runs: | | OpenIDEA | IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3 | | --------------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------- | | Window with the project | **0.9 s** | 3.1 s | | Ready (CPU settled) | **1.1 s** | 13.2 s | | Memory (USS, all processes) | **169 MB** | 2011 MB | | CPU time until ready | **2.4 s** | 47.9 s | | Idle CPU | **4 %** of a core | 7 % of a core | | Quit | **0.3 s** | 5.9 s | A release build of OpenIDEA from `main` and IDEA with default settings and plugins, on Windows 11, 32-core AMD, 62 GB RAM. IDEA analyses Python more deeply, so "ready" doesn't mean the same work on both sides. Both are measured from the outside, the same way: see [`perf/compare`](perf/compare) to run it on your machine and projects. ## Plugins Plugins add actions, completion, quick fixes, tool windows, custom editors, themes, file icons and languages. They run as sandboxed WebAssembly components; themes, icon themes and languages need no code at all. Install them from Settings › Plugins, or start your own with `openidea-plugin new` — see [Writing OpenIDEA plugins](https://openidea.sh/en/plugins) and the [official plugins](plugins/official). The plugin API is still a preview. ## Community - [Discord](https://discord.gg/2Zy4yn7gP) — questions, feedback and release news. - WeChat group — scan to join: - Contributing: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [contributor docs](https://openidea.sh/en/contribute/setup). ## License [Apache 2.0](LICENSE). Bundled third-party assets are listed in [`THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`](THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md). Not affiliated with JetBrains. IntelliJ IDEA is a trademark of JetBrains s.r.o.
detail.readme_zh:
你熟悉的 IDE，用 Rust 重新打造。

English · 简体中文

下载  ·  文档  ·  性能对比  ·  插件  ·  社区  ·  赞助

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/234dd54c-1255-4b3a-b35c-533d78d737c0 OpenIDEA 把 IntelliJ IDEA 的使用方式（快捷键、工具窗口、随处搜索的习惯）带到一个以 Rust 为核心的原生桌面应用里。 编辑器、代码洞察、调试器、Git、终端、数据库客户端和 HTTP 客户端，支持 60 多种语言。 提供 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 版本。 在 macOS 上也可以用 Homebrew 安装： ```bash brew install --cask l0ng-ai/tap/openidea ``` ## 性能对比 在缓存已预热的情况下打开 [freqtrade](https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade)（Python，约 770 个文件）， 取 5 次运行的中位数： | | OpenIDEA | IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3 | | --------------------- | -------------- | ---------------------- | | 显示项目窗口 | **0.9 s** | 3.1 s | | 就绪（CPU 平稳） | **1.1 s** | 13.2 s | | 内存（USS，所有进程） | **169 MB** | 2011 MB | | 就绪前消耗的 CPU 时间 | **2.4 s** | 47.9 s | | 空闲 CPU | 单核的 **4 %** | 单核的 7 % | | 退出 | **0.3 s** | 5.9 s | 测试使用 `main` 分支的 OpenIDEA release 构建，以及默认设置和插件的 IDEA，环境为 Windows 11、 32 核 AMD、62 GB 内存。IDEA 对 Python 的分析更深入，所以两边的“就绪”并不代表完成了同样多的工作。 两者都以相同方式从外部测量：可以用 [`perf/compare`](perf/compare) 在自己的机器和项目上复现。 ## 插件 插件可以添加操作、补全、快速修复、工具窗口、自定义编辑器、主题、文件图标和语言。插件以沙箱化的 WebAssembly 组件运行；主题、图标主题和语言无需编写代码。 在“设置 › 插件”中安装，或用 `openidea-plugin new` 创建自己的插件：参见 [编写 OpenIDEA 插件](https://openidea.sh/zh/plugins)和[官方插件](plugins/official)。插件 API 目前仍是预览版。 ## 社区 - [Discord](https://discord.gg/2Zy4yn7gP)：提问、反馈和版本发布消息。 - 微信群，扫码加入： - 参与贡献：参见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) 和[贡献者文档](https://openidea.sh/zh/contribute/setup)。 ## 赞助 如果 OpenIDEA 帮你节省了时间，可以通过支付宝或微信支付支持它的开发。
